item.title: U.S. Hockey Team Melts Down Gold Medals to Replace Missing Teeth
item.description: MILAN, ITALY — Following their victory over Canada, the US Olympic Hockey Team has continued celebrating by melting down their gold medals to replace all their missing teeth.

item.title: Olympic Curlers Give Final Salute As They Are Lowered Into Carbon-Freezing Chamber Until Next Winter Games
item.description: MILANO — As the 2026 Milano Cortina Olympics came to a close, athletes from various nations participated in the traditional send-offs for their respective sports, with the Olympic curlers being lowered into the carbon-freezing chamber until the next winter games.

item.title: Dad Enters Crossword Era
item.description: SOUTH BEND, IN — According to sources, local husband and father Glenn Riverton has reportedly entered the crossword era of his life.

item.title: Cheer Up, Canada: Here Are 7 Things You're Still Better At Than America
item.description: After a tough stretch at the 2026 Winter Olympics, Canadians are understandably feeling a little down. But it's not all that bad, Canada. There are still reasons to feel good about yourselves.

item.title: Gavin Newsom Wows Black Audience By Putting Some Hot Sauce In His Purple Drank
item.description: ATLANTA, GA — While speaking at the Rialto Center for the Arts as part of promotion for his new memoir, Young Man in a Hurry: A Memoir of Discovery, California Governor Gavin Newsom wowed a black audience by putting some hot sauce into his purple drank.

item.title: Episcopalian Once Again Gives Up Reading Bible For Lent
item.description: CAMBRIDGE, MA — Local Episcopalian Myrtle Smith has once again elected to undergo an enormous sacrifice by giving up reading her Bible again this Lent.

item.title: Report: Trump Just One More Assassination Attempt Away From A Free Third Term
item.description: WASHINGTON, D.C. — With an alleged third assassination attempt in the books, President Trump is reportedly one step closer to a free third term.
